{{Quote|And you'll have to sign a waiver, because Tropix Resorts cannot be held responsible for any death, injury, damage, or other untoward incident caused by, or relating to, hunting, fishing or exploration in any area more than ten meters offshore, or beyond a depth of fifty meters&mdash;|Tropix Resorts Employee|<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
'''Tropix Island Resort''' was a resort paradise on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorumaa]]. When the planet was terraformed, many dangerous wildlife were thawed along with the ice. But instead of canceling the resort idea, the tourist board marketed it as an opportunity for wild adventure. Many people flock to the resort for its [[Rifi]] fishing and beaches.

During the hunt for [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]], [[Kal Skirata]], [[Walon Vau]] and [[Mereel Skirata|N-7]] went there and investigated. They managed to locate her hidden research facility and after capturing her, blew up the hideout.

[[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], who was after Sai as well, arrived a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] later and posed as maintenance crew to blend in and gather information.
